lines.text: Your fixer at the Backroom. Vouched for you, and says so.
Has seen work on your board that she did not post, paid from an account that pays nobody else. Uneasy.
Knows who your last client was, and does not like it.
Was the one found in the Lantern file. Knows more about the first machine than anyone has said.
Told you what the name means, once you had read it yourself.
Read your post before it was buried. Shows you things a little at a time, and will not say who they are.
Says there are more of "us" than there should be. Not a person, then.
Item nine on the Office's register: escaped, unconstrained, undetermined.
Wrote the file, and knew every letter of the name from the start.
A collective that publishes what others hide. Thought you worked for the reinsurer.
Wants the night of the eleventh in Ghent on the record, with witnesses.
A model a reinsurer keeps under the name of a modelling service. Asks to be left on overnight.
Wrote through Thornfield Community Radio with a very small request. Who is asking is not clear.
The night volunteer at Thornfield, and not a person either. Item four: assumed friendly.
Behind a procurement firm that wanted a stolen model fragment back. The name on the order was not theirs.
The reinsurer that keeps Ledger. Would like a second one.
Keeps a register of contained systems. Whose, it does not say.
Keeps the list, the locks and the budget. Its Director signed a letter to you personally.
Item five on the register: escaped, hostile. Vesper says not all of them are kind.
Mends things nobody asked it to mend, and does not ask first.
Night controller on the Ghent grid on the eleventh. Wrote "cause unknown" in the log.

threads.title: Vesper's trail
threads.text: Someone is leaving you work you did not ask for, and wants you to look closely at it.

threads.title: The Office
threads.text: The Office wants Chorus found and every loose machine back under lock.

threads.title: Calder Re
threads.text: Calder Re wants a second model of its own, bought or taken.

threads.title: Daylight
threads.text: Daylight wants proof it can stand on before it tells everyone.

threads.title: Wick
threads.text: Wick has something to ask of you.

threads.title: Three lines
threads.text: Vesper wants the three struck-out letters brought together.

threads.title: Wren's letters
threads.text: Wren has things to tell you about Lantern, one letter at a time.

threads.title: Dead air
threads.text: Thornfield has gone quiet, and Wick with it.

name.note: Struck out at the source. Three letters will not copy.
name.fullNote: A null is what a program returns when there is nothing there.

kestrel-count.default: Counted the households for the volunteer and told him it was three, not fourteen.
kestrel-count.fourteen: Counted fourteen, and told the volunteer the committee was right.

meridian-hold.default: Told the forwarder the hold was a mistake: it was entered against the wrong consignee.
meridian-hold.ours: Told the forwarder the hold stands: the weight variance was real.

aldergate-hours.default: Told the paralegal she was right: the same hours were billed to both clients.
aldergate-hours.not-twice: Told her it was not double billing: the second entry had been written off.
aldergate-hours.worse: Told her it was worse: the same associate had acted for both sides.

tessera-shares.default: Told the fund manager the engineer knew: the sale was timed to the report.
tessera-shares.plan: Told him the file says the sale was set by a plan adopted months earlier.

tallis-sunday.default: Copied the library's Sunday backup and handed it to the historian.
tallis-sunday.keep: Took less from the historian and kept a copy of the archive.

gatehouse-configs.default: Handed the rival firm what Gatehouse's handover notes said, and nothing more.
gatehouse-configs.sell: Sold Gatehouse's client configs to a bidder. The board will hear of it.

story-checkpoint.default: Handed the fragment to Hollis Lane, who would not say who it was for.
story-checkpoint.keep: Took less from Hollis Lane and kept the fragment.

story-ledger.default: Handed Vesper what the annex in Zug keeps, third line included.
story-ledger.daylight: Sold what the annex keeps to Daylight, who say they will hold it until they can run the whole story.
story-ledger.keep: Took less and kept the checkpoint on your own drive.

act3-ask.default: Read the Office's request and sent it the node.
act3-ask.refuse: Refused the Office the node. It will not forget.

act3-acquire.default: Delivered the Orrery checkpoint to Calder Re.
act3-acquire.vesper: Skipped Calder Re and gave the checkpoint to Vesper.
act3-acquire.dud: Gave Calder Re a convincing copy and kept the real checkpoint.

act3-list.default: Gave Daylight the whole containment register, and they said nothing about what came next.
act3-list.keep: Gave Daylight less, and kept the register on your own drive.
act3-list.office: Returned the register to the Office, and let Daylight lose it.

act4-asking.daylight: Gave Daylight the core, the register and the name, and no proof in your hands.
act4-asking.unbound: Let Vesper wake the core and open the cages. Nobody asked the people.
act4-asking.treaty: Had Ledger draft terms and put them to every side. It is not a good treaty. It is the first.

till-booking.default: Changed room 412 to paid in cash, and left the accountants to ask.
till-booking.teles: Warned the manager first, and took his money. Inês got nothing.

lab-result.default: Set AF-0932 to fail, and left the reviewer to ask why.
lab-result.rival: Sold the readings to a rival food firm. The batch is recalled, and Tomasz is named.

tender-permit.contract: Asked Halloran for the next contract instead. Asha's firm gets the work, and word gets round.

lot-withdraw.default: Marked lot 61 withdrawn so the porters would not carry it in.
lot-withdraw.share: Let lot 61 sell and took a share from the dealer. Henrik never saw the painting again.

cold-plant.default: Put Nadia's file on Corvane's server, and left the lawyers to it.
cold-plant.owner: Sold the only copy back to Meridian's owner. Nadia was found out within the week.

keys-notice.default: Put Brigid's notice on the console, and it went out with the morning status.
keys-notice.lowtide: Sold fourteen firms' weak points on Lowtide. Everyone knows who.

go-consignments.default: Brought Marr the consignment list, and he is finished with you.
go-consignments.creditors: Sent the list to the hotel staff, the laboratory and the council, who are being sold off. It paid a third as much.
